title: The body element and visible content
learningObjectives: Identify and assemble the parts of a complete HTML document

understand.concept: The body contains page content such as headings, paragraphs, links, images and forms.
understand.whyItMatters: Separating metadata from page content makes documents easier to maintain.
understand.analogy: A theatre has backstage preparation and a stage performance; this is only a memory aid, not a literal mapping.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a memory aid; HTML should not be interpreted literally through it.

explain.narrative: The body contains page content such as headings, paragraphs, links, images and forms.

examples.explanation: The browser displays Welcome and the paragraph.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser displays Welcome and the paragraph.

practise.guidedTask: Place a heading and paragraph inside body, not head.
practise.independentTask: Create your own small page, open it in a browser and inspect the result.
hints: Check that each element is nested under the correct parent.
